name: Guild Rush (proto)
customHelp:
Guild Rush (proto) · dungeon: Goblin Mine. Full rules: livret/en/livret.md in the repository.
Goal: the most treasure. End: a player at 12 treasure at the end of a round, or boss killed (end of that turn). Tie: the boss killer, then the most monsters killed.
Board: 4 rooms in a row (neighbor = ±1), one monster each. Facing each room, one Expedition per player (3 units max, tokens included). The Camp touches all your Expeditions, no limit; it isn't a room.
Turn: Rest (energy to max, 3 then +1 per round up to 6; draw 1; heal Recovering units; Guardian passive) → Scheme (Scouts, face-down Bluff, break camp) → Assault → Withdrawal (treasure to the counter, Terrain level).
Assault: a unit you play arrives directly in the Expedition you want or in the Camp (TCG Arena puts it in Exp. 1: drag it). A unit in play moves once per turn (neighboring Expedition, Camp, or from the Camp to any Expedition). Wounded: only toward the Camp (Recovering).
Combat (optional), room by room, in any order: declare your attackers and each one's target, then Duel (announce it in the chat; the opponent plays or passes first, then Reflex / Terrain bonus / pass; 2 passes = strikes). Then the monster strikes 1 present attacker chosen by the opponent (even if you target something else), your attackers all strike at the same time, then (Brawl) the enemy units in the room strike the target of their choice. 1 strike per unit per player turn.
Killing blow: the killer (controller of the last damage) takes all the treasure and the relic. Fall back: if the opponent kills the monster during a Brawl, your units that attacked may return to the Camp. A spell is cast in a room where you have a unit (Reach: or neighboring).
Raid (from round 2, 1 per Assault): after a kill in a room, your units in that room attack the enemy Camp. Success if more raiders than standing defenders (Guardian included): 1 treasure stolen, +1 if the Guardian is Knocked out.
Monster killed: the host puts it in “Defeated monsters”, the killer adds its treasure (gold badge) to their counter. Relic icon: “Take the relic” in the Dungeon panel. Automatic: empty rooms refilled at the start of each turn; evolution at the end of the round.
Terrain: starts next to the Guardian, drag it to an Expedition on your 1st Assault. Lvl 1 when placed, +1 at Withdrawal if it didn't move (3 max, lvl 3 = Stronghold). Break camp: neighboring Expedition, -1 level. Destroyed by the opponent: +1 treasure for them (plunder), comes back at lvl 1 on your next Assault.
Counter = Treasure. HP and Power: card counters (right click > Toggle counter 1 = HP, key C; counter 2 = Power, Ctrl C). Tokens to drag onto cards: Resource (Sap, Arcana or Wager: 1 token = 1, on your Terrain), Level 1-3, states (Stunned, Poisoned, Swift, Unflinching, Tipsy, Hangover, Backlash, Snared, Recovering, Aegis, Trap).
Deck: 1 Guardian + 1 Terrain of its faction + 30 cards of the faction, including 20 min. from the Guardian's pool (3 copies max, Signature 1). TCG Arena doesn't check the rule of 20.
Sprout, Wolf and Glyph token cards: right click on the card that summons or places them. A Glyph goes in your Expedition facing its room (outside the limit of 3).
Language: Options menu (English / Français).

GLOSSARY (bible/en/00_glossaire_en.md; recalled at the bottom of the cards that use it)
Brawl: both players in the same room. Order: monster, active player, opponent. The killing blow takes everything.
Fall back: if the opponent kills the monster during a Brawl, a unit that attacked may return to the Camp (not if Snared).
Plunder: destroying the enemy Terrain = +1 treasure.
Wounded: unit with at least 1 damage on its base HP. Normal movement: only toward the Camp.
Break camp: move the Terrain to a neighboring Expedition (-1 level).
Signature: 1 copy max per deck.
Swift: after its combat on your Assault, the unit may change room (outside the movement limit) and attack 1 more time.
Reflex: playable in a Duel. Without Reflex, a spell is played on your Assault, outside a Duel.
Reach: the unit can attack in a room neighboring its Expedition; the monster doesn't strike back; it doesn't count as present in that room (no Brawl, no Stronghold, no Fall back). Respects Protector. On a spell: it can target a room neighboring one of your units.
Reinforce: triggers when the unit is called back to the Camp during a raid.
Protector: an attack (unit or monster) against your units or your Terrain in its room must target it. Spells, effects and Ambushes target freely. Protects even when Stunned; in a raid, comes before the Guardian.
Scout: played at Scheme, directly in the chosen Expedition, and doesn't change room this turn. Its "Scheme:" effect triggers again at each of your Schemes while it is in an Expedition.
Bluff: placed face down in an Expedition at Scheme, revealed at Assault.
Try your luck: reveal the top card of your deck, then put it at the bottom of your deck. Success if its cost is 2 or more. Empty deck: failure.
Ambush: effect when it arrives.
Stunned: doesn't strike in its next combat. Stunned during its attack: that attack is canceled.
Poisoned: -1 HP at each of its owner's Rests, until healed.
Unflinching: can't be Stunned this turn (Whisky).
Tipsy: drank a drink this turn (a 2nd = Stunned).
Hangover: Stunned until the end of your next turn (Rum).
Backlash: -2 HP at your next Rest (Absinthe).
Snared: can't change room (Web).
Recovering: wounded unit that arrived at the Camp. Fully healed at your next Rest, then stays at the Camp until the end of that turn.
Knocked out: Guardian at 0 HP, no longer defends; comes back at its next Rest (HP to max).
Trap: face-down token set by a Scout on its room (1 per player per room, outside the limit of 3). Triggers on the 1st enemy unit that enters the room (tokens included), then discarded.
Wager: token on the Betting Keg (3 max), gained per monster killed here. 3 Wagers = 1 treasure at Withdrawal. Lost if the barrel explodes.
Decoy: Trap with no effect, set instead of the real one to bluff.
Aegis: ignores the next hit received (all its damage, from one source), then disappears. Doesn't stack. Doesn't block HP losses (Poisoned, Backlash).
Glyph: face-up token placed by a Mage on a room (2 max per player per room, outside the limit of 3). The 1st enemy unit that enters the room or attacks in it (Reach included) takes 1 damage and is Stunned, then a Glyph is removed. Only 1 Glyph triggers per unit per turn.
Pint: -1 HP to the barrel (-2 strong drink) → effect on a unit.
Soak: once per turn, the barrel takes all the damage of one hit instead of one of your units in its room.
Sap: tokens on the grove (4 max), pay for recipes.
Arcana: tokens on the circle (4 max), +1 per spell you cast, pay for Incantations. An Incantation isn't a spell.
Overload: up to 6, each token above 4 deals 1 damage to the circle at your Rest.

draggableTokens.name: Sonné : ne frappe pas à son prochain combat
Empoisonné : perd 1 PV à chaque Repos de son propriétaire, jusqu'à être soigné
Insensible : ne peut pas être Sonné ce tour (Whisky)
Ivre : a bu un alcool ce tour (un 2e = Sonné)
Gueule de bois : Sonné jusqu'à la fin de ton prochain tour (Rhum)
Contrecoup : perd 2 PV à ton prochain Repos (Absinthe)
Entravé : ne peut pas changer de salle (Toile)
En soin : blessé au Camp, soigné à ton prochain Repos puis reste au Camp ce tour
Ressource : Sève, Arcane ou Mise, sur ton Terrain (1 jeton = 1)
Égide : ignore le prochain coup reçu

Boss.displayedTitle: Boss (entre quand la pioche est vide)

children.children: {{ game.data.Donjon.boss ? 'Le boss est entré !' : 'Pioche : ' + game.data.Donjon.pioche + ' monstre(s)' }}

children.onClick: const d=game.data.Donjon;const r=d.reliques||[];if(!r.length){functions.chatLog('Plus aucune relique dans le donjon.');return;}const id=r[0];d.reliques=r.slice(1);await functions.createCard(id,'Camp');functions.chatLog('Relique gagnée : '+({"lanterne": "Lanterne du mineur", "pioche-runique": "Pioche runique", "bourse": "Bourse du contremaître"}[id]||id)+' (au Camp).');await functions.repositionCards();

props.title: Lanterne : le monstre du dessus de la pioche passe en dessous

children.onClick: const d=game.data.Donjon;if(!game.isHost){d.lanterne=Date.now();functions.chatLog('Lanterne : demande envoyée à l’hôte.');return;}d.lanterne=Date.now();d.lanterneFait=d.lanterne;const n=(cards.Monstres??[]).length;if(n<2){functions.chatLog('Lanterne : rien à réordonner.');}else{await functions.drawFromExtraDeck('Monstres',1,false,'Coulisse');for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){await functions.drawFromExtraDeck('Monstres',1,true,'Coulisse');}for(let i=0;i<n;i++){await functions.drawFromExtraDeck('Coulisse',1,true,'Monstres');}functions.chatLog('Lanterne : le monstre du dessus est passé sous la pioche.');await functions.repositionCards();}

events.onUpdate: if(!game.isHost)return;const d=game.data.Donjon;if(d.lanterne&&d.lanterne!==d.lanterneFait){d.lanterneFait=d.lanterne;const n=(cards.Monstres??[]).length;if(n<2){functions.chatLog('Lanterne : rien à réordonner.');}else{await functions.drawFromExtraDeck('Monstres',1,false,'Coulisse');for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){await functions.drawFromExtraDeck('Monstres',1,true,'Coulisse');}for(let i=0;i<n;i++){await functions.drawFromExtraDeck('Coulisse',1,true,'Monstres');}functions.chatLog('Lanterne : le monstre du dessus est passé sous la pioche.');await functions.repositionCards();}}
